findings.title: Type check fails: .ts import extension without allowImportingTsExtensions
findings.why: src/index.test.ts imports "./index.ts", and tsconfig.json includes "src". It sets no allowImportingTsExtensions, and with outDir and no noEmit it can't be turned on alone. tsc therefore reports TS5097 (an import path can only end with .ts when allowImportingTsExtensions is enabled). The README examples import "./src/index.ts" too. I checked by reading tsconfig.json and the test imports; I did not run tsc.

findings.title: Tests cover only resolvePointer and createPatch
findings.why: The test file imports only resolvePointer and createPatch. applyPatch and applyMergePatch, which carry many spec scenarios (sparse patch, move, test, prototype safety), have no tests.
